pages.title: The Empty Tool Was a Clue
pages.text: A new modular tool feels plain because capacitors, tools, bows, staffs, and chestpieces are only hosts. Their tier decides grid space and acceptable module tiers.$(br2)A better host makes room for more powerful effects; the bare item does not arrive with every ability already inside.

pages.title: Reserve Energy First
pages.text: Most powered equipment needs Energy Modules before its capacity and transfer feel useful. Even a capacitor needs suitable energy modules and an outside OP source before it can charge other items.$(br2)Reserve energy space first, then plan damage, mining area, speed, shields, or flight.

pages.title: Wyvern Equipment
pages.text: Wyvern tools and armor come from Fusion, not a workbench. Each host follows its own recipe and commonly begins with a familiar tool or core as catalyst.$(br2)A recipe display can reveal the exact list; otherwise the Fusion Core confirms an arrangement once every required piece is present.

pages.title: Draconic Equipment
pages.text: Draconic equipment is another Fusion step beyond Wyvern gear. The Staff consumes earlier Draconic tools, so retain them while climbing the chain.$(br2)Only the finished item is pictured here—the book's ordinary recipe frame cannot portray a Fusion arrangement.

pages.title: Capacitors
pages.text: Capacitors are Fusion products too. Wyvern and Draconic versions follow their matching cores, energy cores, and tier materials.$(br2)Exact counts come from the current recipe. Where no recipe display is available, treat this note as a trail marker rather than an ingredient ledger.
